data.match_policy: original DataProcess.match_bboxes, first 11 tracked boxes by list index
data.keep: matched behavior-labelled pedestrians and frames present in JAAD annotation

split.method: torch random_split style random permutation of windows
split.normalization: same as original Dataset: fitted before split over all loaded samples; retained for paper/code fidelity

limitations: original sample selection and random seed unavailable
window-level split can share videos/persons and adjacent frames across train/validation
normalization uses validation data as in recovered code; not a leakage-free benchmark
GPU batching and omission of visualization overlays can create small feature differences from the original workflow
config.purpose: Paper/code-style ST-GCN internal validation, intentionally not an independent test
